text:
Maya: Ran a perfetto capture of e2e requests where tail latency jumps around 200-600ms intermittently. Attached trace: https://perfetto.local/trace/42
Lin: saw similar on prod yesterday, looks like kernel pick fluctuates when kvcache hitrate dips
Sam: can you paste the timeline snippet? also did you run with NVTX markers?
Maya: yanked the slice, NVTX present. client->gateway span is fine, gap starts when runtime issues kernel-switch RPC to worker. snippet:
```
client->gateway: 0.6ms
gateway->runtime dispatch: 1.2ms	runtime: kvcache lookup: 1.6ms	runtime: kernel selection: 120ms	kernel launch: 6ms
```
Lin: kernel selection 120ms is the weird part. maybe batch heuristic loop is re-scanning candidate kernels after a KV miss
infra-bot: canary deploy 2.8.0-rc3 rolled at 03:10 UTC (no incidents) :rocket:
Sam: idea: instrument kernel-selection with histograms and early-exit log on >20ms
Maya: attached nsys nvtx export + perfetto slice id 42 (exported flame + timeline)
Lin: looking at the host CPU thread — appears blocked doing memcpy while waiting on kvcache eviction lock
Maya: repro steps: run 10k short prompts @100qps with kvcache size 128k, observe waveform and correlated NVTX ranges
Ops: can we add a temporary metric: runtime.kernel_select_ms p50/p95/p99 and runtime.kvcache_hit_rate?
Sam: I'll add the metric and a perfetto filter. Also try toggling prefetch heuristic to see delta.
Maya: running a 30m run now, will post updated trace when complete
Lin: thx. also check recent scheduler change that touched batch windowing (PR #4526) — could affect when we re-evaluate kernels
Maya: update: 30m run shows spikes aligned with cache thrash events, kernel_select p99 ~220ms, p50 ~5ms
Sam: hypothesis: repeated KV misses cause batch window to shrink which triggers kernel re-eval + heavier path (quantized vs fp) -> latency spike. we should add a guard that avoids full kernel re-eval mid-batch
Maya: pinging @eng-runtime — can someone take ownership for a follow-up FR and triage?
Lin: I'll pick it up, will open RFC and attach the perfetto + nsys exports and a short repro script
Maya: :thumbsup:
